meta_description:
79K likes, 428 comments - janhvikapoor on September 17, 2026: "Today, @offtherocksofficial and @amaha.health took a meaningful step.

I was grateful to spend time at Kripa Foundation, one of Mumbai’s oldest de-addiction centres, learning from the people who have quietly dedicated themselves to helping others find their way back from addiction.

I was especially moved by their new day-care centre for children under 18, some as young as 10, struggling with addiction or living in unsafe homes affected by a parent’s addiction. It is an increasingly urgent issue that remains inadequately addressed. Kripa also makes recovery accessible at a very nominal cost, ensuring that financial circumstances do not become another barrier to seeking help.

It felt particularly meaningful to be there today, on the birth anniversary of our Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, and at the beginning of the Seva Sankalp Abhiyan; a month dedicated to the spirit of seva and contributing to the lives of others.

To me, seva is simple: giving your time, attention and support where they can make a difference. Kripa has been doing exactly that for decades, in a space too often hidden by shame and stigma.

Today was also a reminder that addiction should not be mistaken for a moral failing. It is an illness, and it deserves compassion, treatment and the opportunity for recovery.

If you know someone who needs help, or would like to support the work at Kripa Foundation, please reach out:

+91 93246 92520

@kripafoundationofficial 

Sometimes, the first step towards recovery is simply knowing where to turn.".
